title: Graduate computational physics
purpose: Design numerical experiments with convergence, stability and reproducibility checks and distinguish numerical artifacts.
primary_reading: MIT 12.010 Computational Methods of Scientific Programming

blocks.deliverable: Measure cancellation or conditioning in a controlled example.
Check residuals and compare two solvers.
Measure energy drift over long integration times.
Midcourse practical assessment; derive or test a stability limit.
Estimate sampling error with dependence taken into account.
Recover known synthetic parameters and disclose model assumptions.
Deliver executable code, environment instructions and a defended report.

project: Reproduce a published or textbook benchmark and report an independently validated numerical result.
completion: finish the final project and practical or oral assessment, repair issues found during review, and retain the full data or code and a short account of remaining limitations.
